scope: One admitted native-byte domain's bounded value-only event history. Values hold numeric identities, never a pointer, owner reference or usable native authority. Event byte semantics are kind-specific and never process RSS.
consistency: Each event is assembled under the admission-domain lock immediately after its actual transition, with that transition's committed/reserved gauges. Copy preserves chronological order of the retained newest suffix; concurrent later activity cannot change copied values.
resetPolicy: No reset or consuming read. Bounded ring overwrite drops the oldest event and records loss. Short destinations receive the newest suffix. Physical cleanup and checked authority changes do not depend on trace retention.
historyOverflow: Sequence exhaustion stops recording without wrap or overwrite, marks trace overflow and records dropped events. Dropped history saturates with the trace flag. Domain history overflow is separate. Disabled tracing constructs no event and samples no clock.
availability: OwnerId, AllocationOrdinal, CorrelationId and Generation are nullable: null is explicitly unavailable/inapplicable, not zero. Actual initial generation zero is represented as zero. Mandatory fields are actual values even when genuinely zero; trace disabled means no events, not synthetic zero-valued records.
oracleScope: Independent public operations model direct growth/refusal/move/return, pending-to-prepared permission cancellation, ownerless refusal and initial generation cleanup. Independently sampled Stopwatch bounds validate timestamps, rather than copying producer values. Local fault injection, seeded sequence exhaustion and existing nonzero/retired/quarantined/detached generation tests remain separately identified.
unreviewedScope: Closing these twelve payload definitions does not certify every trace kind, API/lifecycle/exception edge, owner/layout diagnostic field, benchmark benefit, platform or final release boundary.

fields.name: Sequence
fields.definition: Strictly increasing lifetime recording sequence. Ring suffixes retain original ordinals; disabled tracing creates no ordinal. Exhaustion cannot wrap or erase the last recorded value.
fields.overflow: At Int64.MaxValue recording stops with sticky TraceOverflowed; real allocation/free continues.

fields.name: TimestampTicks
fields.definition: Actual Stopwatch.GetTimestamp at event recording, not DateTime ticks or UTC. Independent external before/after samples bound each event; retained event timestamps are nondecreasing.
fields.overflow: Platform Stopwatch representation; interpreted in its monotonic clock domain, not converted into wall-clock dates.

fields.name: BudgetId
fields.definition: Immutable admission domain identity of the event's actual charge owner, shared by all owners using that domain.
fields.overflow: Budget identity construction is checked and cannot wrap.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.definition: Actual backing/control owner lineage when supplied. Ownerless refusal or metadata failure has null, never a fabricated owner zero; moves preserve lineage.
fields.overflow: Non-wrapping owner construction; null denotes unavailable lineage.

fields.name: Kind
fields.definition: Actual emitted admission, backing, ownership, permission, layout or generation transition. Physical release is not inferred from logical return; enum members alone do not prove all paths executed.
fields.overflow: Finite event kind; diagnostic absence is not inferred as successful cleanup.

fields.name: RequestedBytes
fields.definition: Known extent associated with this transition: backend admission/allocation/reallocation/free extent; ownership-associated extent; declared permission extent; layout preparation backing versus layout initialization typed logical bytes; generation's still-owned extent at transition, possibly zero after transfer or prior finalization. Never generic RSS or automatically logical payload length.
fields.overflow: Producer checked extent arithmetic; generation extents may be real zero and cannot invent freed-byte credit.

fields.name: PreviousBytes
fields.definition: Actual complete prior backing extent only for reallocation, including real zero for realloc-from-null. Zero is the defined invariant for other events.
fields.overflow: Checked backing arithmetic, not reconstructed from event-history differences.

fields.name: CommittedBytes
fields.definition: Exact domain committed charge immediately after this event's transition, including retained/retired/quarantined backing until physical return. Not the event owner alone or current capture time.
fields.overflow: Nonnegative exact charge bounded by domain capacity, independent of saturated histories.

fields.name: ReservedBytes
fields.definition: Exact domain admission not yet committed immediately after transition. Permission backing failure retains its original reserved charge; successful commit transfers it to committed without double count.
fields.overflow: Exact capacity-bounded gauge; diagnostics never forgive pending charge after failure.

fields.name: AllocationOrdinal
fields.definition: Genuine backing acquisition lineage when supplied, preserved for same backing realloc/move/return. Admission, pre-backing failure and generation summaries can be unavailable; null is not acquisition ordinal zero.
fields.overflow: Checked source ordinal cannot wrap; unsupplied ordinal is explicitly null.

fields.name: CorrelationId
fields.definition: Actual ownership control, typed layout identity, detach operation identity or generation as specified by the event kind. Ordinary backing events can be unavailable; initial generation identity zero is genuine, not absence.
fields.overflow: Checked control/layout identities and actual generation identity; null remains unavailable.

fields.name: Generation
fields.definition: CorrelationId only for GenerationDetached, GenerationRetired, GenerationQuarantined and GenerationReleased. The initial generation is real zero; every other event has unavailable generation even when its owner has a generation.
fields.overflow: Actual non-reused generation; no invented generation from sequence or owner identity.
